13b-t.reason: Same inline-4 turbo-diesel size class as the stock 2L-TE, but from a different vehicle family — physically compatible with the bay but requires custom mounts and wiring rather than a direct bolt-in.

1hd-t.reason: The lj78 is a 4-cylinder-only chassis by design; the 1HD-T inline-6 will not fit the stock bay without major surgery (core support relocation, firewall modification) — not a known/documented swap.

1kz-te.reason: The 1KZ-TE is the factory engine in the successor Prado 90-series (KZJ78/79) chassis, which shares mounts, bellhousing pattern, and driveshaft flange with the lj78 — a well-documented, straightforward swap.
